description: A regtest chain captured whole as the DRS-E2 replay pair. corpus.e2: every block 0..=tip_height with the FULL bytes of every listed transaction, read at connect and verified by CorpusWriter (RD-F15). trace.e2: the Rust baseline (shekyl-chain-replay baseline): the corpus replayed against a fresh store, then each height's facts and the tip's digest and archival rows read off it, pinned at baseline_built_at_dev_sha. A regression gate, not a conformance oracle. Consumed by replay: shekyl-chain-ingest connects the chain against a real store, so the state the 4.I rules read is derived, not asserted. Regenerate with SHEKYL_CAPTURE_CHAIN_VECTORS=1, SHEKYL_PINNED_REGEN_DECISION="YYYY-MM-DD <rationale>" citing DAEMON_REDB_STORE.md §12.1, SHEKYLD_BIN and SHEKYL_CHAIN_REPLAY_BIN set to binaries built at that same HEAD, running the named generator --ignored.
regen_decision: 2026-11-15 NI-R18 (Rick): genesis carries its mint time, so every genesis moved (regtest 5a6ab91e); the capturable chains are re-captured on it
trace_rebaseline_decision: 2026-11-21 CF-4b (Rick): the trace carries the tables digest at each indexed event (TRACE_VERSION 0x02); trace.e2 re-baselined over the unchanged corpus, no block moved
